lav.nota_tarata: Estimates calibrated on this Mac on {data}.
lav.nota_fabbrica: Factory estimates: use "Calibrate now" next to Calibration in the sidebar to tune them to this Mac in ~10 minutes.
lav.fine_giorni_diversi: Started on {giorno_inizio} at {inizio}, finished on {giorno_fine} at {fine}
lav.tar_intro: Measures how fast this Mac really is, so every estimate uses its own speed instead of figures from another Mac. Needed only the first time; recalibrate whenever you want to update the numbers.
lav.tar_intro_dettagli: Every model at every scale is timed, plus frame extraction, x265 encoding and the dedup scan. It also picks the fastest number of save threads, which real jobs then use.
lav.tar_mai: This Mac has never been calibrated: estimates use factory figures.
lav.tar_occupata: A job is running: the timer would measure a busy GPU and every number would be wrong. Use Stop all in the Processing bar, or wait for the queue to end, then open this again.
lav.tar_prima: Close video editors, games and browsers playing video, and plug in a laptop: anything else on the CPU or GPU skews the numbers.
lav.tar_chiudibile: You can close this window: calibration carries on in the background and saves itself. Until it ends, Start processing and Resume are disabled, and it's best not to use anything heavy on this Mac.
lav.tar_nel_frattempo: In the meantime, avoid starting anything CPU- or GPU-heavy, as it could throw off the measurements.
lav.tar_da_ora: From now on, every estimate on this Mac uses the updated values.
lav.tar_ripetibile: You can recalibrate at any time with the Redo button next to Calibration in the sidebar.
lav.tar_nota_scarto: Note: the change is measured against the previous calibration if there is one, otherwise against the factory figures.
lav.av_fase3: phase 3/3 · encoding and assembly · {passo} · {totale} frames processed · {trascorso} elapsed
lav.av_fase2_codifica: phase 2/3 · encoding chunk{perc}{quale} (CPU) · {fatti}/{totale} frames · upscale resumes shortly · {trascorso} elapsed
lav.av_in_pausa: paused at {perc} · {fatti}/{totale} frames · resumes from here
lav.mon_riprendibile: resume it by starting the same file again
lav.det_analisi: Analysing: the details appear as soon as the report is ready.
lav.avvia_no_lanciatore: Launcher not found at {percorso}: the job didn't start.
lav.avvia_taratura: A calibration is running: the job would share the GPU with it, and the calibration would save wrong numbers. Wait for it to finish, then start again.
lav.avvia_fallito: The job didn't start (exit code {codice}). More details in the log: `{registro}`
lav.avviata: Started: {quanti}{coda}. You can close this page. Log: `{registro}`
lav.spento_chiudi: You can close this window and the Terminal window.
lav.spento_lavori: The running job will carry on in the background and will be there next time you open AnimeUp.
lav.pausa_senza_processo: the job no longer has a process to talk to
lav.pausa_non_risponde: the job isn't responding any more
lav.pausa_niente: there's nothing to pause right now (the job is changing phase)
lav.fine_testo_fallito: It stopped with an error; the work done is kept and Resume continues from there. The file's log says why.
lav.fine_testo_fermato: Stopped before the end. Resume it from its row.
lav.fine_testo_scartato: It couldn't be planned with these settings and was left out of the queue.
lav.tar_salvata_nota: Every estimate on this Mac now uses these values. Recalibrate any time from Preferences.
lav.tar_niente_salvato: Nothing was saved: estimates keep using the previous figures. Check the free space on the disk of Finished videos, close other apps, then try again.
lav.avvia_gia: A queue is already running: wait for it to finish, or stop it first.
lav.fine_testo_non_avviato: The queue stopped before reaching this file.
lav.fine_testo_difettoso: The output failed its check and was set aside as .DEFECTIVE. Run it again.
lav.d_preparo: **Getting the upscale ready** · loading the model and the first chunk's frames
lav.d_pausa: **Paused at {perc}** · nothing is lost on resume
lav.d_pausa_blocco: **Paused at {perc}** · chunk {n} of {blocchi} · **{fatti}** of **{totale}** frames upscaled · nothing is lost on resume
